title: Ace Archer
description: Dodge incoming projectiles across crisp roguelike dungeon rooms, stop to unleash rapid spread-shot volleys, and stack crazy arrow power-ups.
controls: Drag anywhere to dodge enemy shots and reposition; release to automatically loose rapid arrow volleys at the nearest enemy.

zh-CN.title: 王牌射手
zh-CN.description: 经典弓箭传说式肉鸽走位射击：单手拖动灵巧躲弹幕，停步瞬间自动连发散射神箭，叠加超爽词条一路清图打 Boss！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动控制射手走位躲避弹幕，松手即自动瞄准最近敌人连续射箭，升级任选强化技能。
